description: This source file contains unit tests for client-addressable objects in Orleans. It includes test classes and methods that verify client object registration, method invocation, error handling, pull model, and stress testing in an Orleans cluster.

classes.name: ClientAddressableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying client-addressable objects in Orleans, including happy path, error handling, pull model, and stress tests.

classes.name: MyPseudoGrain
classes.description: Client-side object implementing IClientAddressableTestClientObject for testing method invocation, error propagation, and concurrency handling.

classes.name: MyProducer
classes.description: Client-side producer implementing IClientAddressableTestProducer for testing the pull model from grains.

methods.name: TestClientAddressableHappyPath
methods.description: Verifies successful invocation of client methods from grains and proper cleanup.

methods.name: TestClientAddressableSadPath
methods.description: Verifies error propagation from client to grain when client method throws an exception.

methods.name: GrainShouldSuccessfullyPullFromClientObject
methods.description: Tests the pull pattern where grains request data from client objects.

methods.name: MicroClientAddressableSerialStressTest
methods.description: Performs serial stress testing to verify state consistency and proper serialization.

methods.name: MicroClientAddressableParallelStressTest
methods.description: Performs parallel stress testing to verify concurrent access handling and thread safety.
